selected_program.name: low_max_abs
selected_program.source: frozen after the four-regime development screen; unchanged through long development

freshness_scope: bodies 9 and 10 were not used for program discovery, selection, or tuning; they participated in earlier unrelated mechanisms, so this is fresh-to-program replication rather than an entirely untouched benchmark
execution: on-policy pre-FFN features; exact per-layer Top-B; padding excluded; gather/scatter; real AdamW; no router learning
primary_endpoints: low_max_abs minus random sparse held-out loss at steps 50, 100, 150, and 200 in all four regimes
low_max_abs minus random sparse held-out accuracy at the same evaluations
interpolated loss at dense-fewer total cost and random total cost
realized active fraction and auxiliary operation estimates

decision_rules.fresh_to_program_level_2_confirmation: low_max_abs beats random at step 200 in all four fresh-to-program body-budget regimes without any recipe changes
decision_rules.failed_replication: any final regime loss difference against random is nonnegative; do not tune the program on these runs
decision_rules.fresh_to_program_level_3: low_max_abs also beats dense-fewer at matched total cost in every regime; development cost gaps make this unlikely and no such claim is presupposed

prohibited: changing the program, budgets, seeds, or training settings after seeing results
claiming practical efficiency from wins over random alone
omitting auxiliary operations or substituting dense-body quality for sparse-deployment quality
